content: As mentioned above, we recorded two different reading tasks for the ZuCo 2.0 dataset. During both tasks the participants were able to read in their own speed, using a control pad to move to the next sentence and to answer the control questions, which allowed for natural reading. Since each subject reads at their own personal pace, the reading speed between varies between subjects. Table TABREF4 shows the average reading speed for each task, i.e. the average number of seconds a subject spends per sentence before switching to the next one.
